public_boundary.central_allegation: Por Derecho investigates whether the Acosta Matos and RIC Private Equity perimeters designed, exploited or preserved a multi-stage sequence assisted by knowing, reckless, negligent or passive enablers.

actor_perimeters.name: Acosta Matos / CAM / HNT
actor_perimeters.test: initiation, representations, calculations, omissions, benefit and transfer

actor_perimeters.name: RIC Private Equity perimeter
actor_perimeters.test: sponsorship, conflicts, abstentions, conditions, waivers, funding and disclosure

actor_perimeters.name: Insolvency Administration
actor_perimeters.test: estate protection, independent verification, accounts, loyalty and causation

actor_perimeters.name: Judge
actor_perimeters.test: what was decided, evidence, adversarial process, reasoning, authority and undecided issues

actor_perimeters.name: LAJ / judicial office
actor_perimeters.test: filings, annexes, notice, appeals, finality, execution and docket traceability

actor_perimeters.name: Notary / Land Registry
actor_perimeters.test: title, authority, calculation, finca scope, warnings and effective entries

actor_perimeters.name: Valuers / lawyers / experts / operators
actor_perimeters.test: inputs, limitations, transmission, gatekeeping and lost or preserved routes

actor_perimeters.name: Authorities / supervisors / funding bodies
actor_perimeters.test: specific notice, competence, preservation, verification, referral and inaction

hypothesis_families: punishable insolvency or frustration of recovery
conflict, corruption or improper influence where specifically evidenced
knowing unjust decision where the subjective threshold is evidenced
conversion or laundering of allegedly unlawful benefit
direct, joint, induced, necessary-cooperation, complicity and corporate participation modes

priority_issues.title: Texto definitivo versus debt used in 2022
Offer, 2021 order, protocol 457 and final accounts
LPB, Matkator and third-party asset perimeter
RICPE conflict, due diligence, reactivation and use of money
Administrator control, loyalty, accounts and causation

evidence_gates: complete certified court and LexNET chain
complete definitive creditor texts and every modification
legal basis for every component of EUR 13,168,082.02
proof of five-day court notification of protocol 457
complete EUR 400,000 bank, ledger, deed and registry chain
final liquidation accounts and conclusion order
historic and current finca-by-finca registry certificates
RICPE board, committee, conflict, due-diligence, waiver and funding files
actor-specific communications, instructions and exculpatory evidence
retaliation and preservation evidence where alleged
